notes.text: A search engine in four states: accepts any stream containing cat, car, or cab. The Σ self-loop keeps scan alive at every position, so the machine attempts a match everywhere at once — exactly how grep-style multi-pattern search works.
Run cart and watch several states glow at the same time — that parallelism is the NFA superpower. crab is rejected: no complete keyword.

meta.title: Keyword search: cat | car | cab
meta.blurb: Accepts any string that contains cat, car, or cab. The Σ self-loops let the NFA start a match at every position simultaneously — multi-pattern text search as an automaton.
